clips.title: The story
paras: Highperch is an elevated plateau in western Thousand Needles, towering high above the canyon floor. It is renowned as a primary nesting ground for wild wyverns and wind riders. The roost is home to fierce prides defending their young among the windswept crags.

Rising sharply out of the canyon floor, Highperch is a rugged sanctuary for Kalimdor's native wyverns. The plateau provides natural defense against predators and an unobstructed launch point for their hunting flights across Thousand Needles. Within its reaches, wyvern prides live under the protection of watchful patriarchs and matriarchs, guarding their nests. The beasts fiercely defend their territory against any intruders who manage to climb into their high domain.

While hostile to outsiders, the high cliffs occasionally attract travellers and hunters willing to brave the dangerous ascent. The tauren scout Pao'ka Swiftmountain is stranded on these perilous heights and needs help reaching Whitereach Post. For adventurers journeying through the canyon, scaling the ramp to Highperch means contending with dozens of razor-sharp talons and venomous tails.
